text:
Sam (Growth): Quick check-in 50m: final copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages + webinar gating the benchmark kit. Need clear CTAs and routing.
Ivy (Content): Draft heroes: Hosted: "Launch fast, iterate often." Dedicated: "Throughput you can budget for." Private: "Keep inference inside your network." Short bullets under each: latency, cost predictability, deployment.
Theo (PMM): Make sure public pages use conservative language for benchmarks: "verified profiles". Full p50/p95 and methodology go in the gated kit and webinar.
Bea (Design): Will mock three hero variants and one shared benchmark teaser (abstract visuals). Two A/B directions: speed-first and economics-first.
Omar (Sales Ops): Routing matrix: Hosted CTA -> product nurture (no AE); Dedicated CTA -> AE queue "Reserved-Enterprise"; Private CTA -> security intake + AE. Add hidden param mode_hint on CTAs for fallback routing.
Ivy (Content): CTA microcopy suggestions: Hosted: "Start free  no card"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity  talk to sales"; Private: "Request private eval  security first". Also add a small note on Private: "Supports customer-managed keys."
Sam (Growth): Webinar plan: 40m demo + benchmark walk-through, 20m Q&A. Registrant fields: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case. Those map to AE tags.
webinar-bot: Publishing the webinar page will auto-create HubSpot campaign id=launchpad-tri-mode-2026 and append utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch to demo links. It will also create form fields: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case.
Omar (Sales Ops): SLA: AE follow-up within 24h for Dedicated/Private leads with tokens >10M. Hosted leads go into activation email flow. I'll draft HubSpot workflows after copy freeze.
Bea (Design): Uploading comps by 6pm. Keep hero verbs consistent (Start / Reserve / Request) so A/B is clean.
Ivy (Content): I'll push 6 headline variants (2 per mode) by noon. Tone = developer-first, factual.
Sam (Growth): Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow 10am PT, designs by 6pm, QA Wed, soft launch Fri. Last call for edits, please flag anything now. :white_check_mark:
